lead.title: Agora Labs (Rome) raises €4.3M led by P101 SGR to make hospital data usable for research
lead.deck: GPU compute nodes installed in hospitals structure and anonymize records without them leaving the hospital system; ~50 facilities already connected, aiming to double the network and enter the US. A bet on the RWE market ahead of the EHDS.

milestone.title: York and Scarborough: second tranche of Nervecentre EPR live, ambient voice and 4,000 Copilot licences
milestone.summary: Nervecentre EPR (May 2026) now covers emergency care, pathology, radiology, ePMA and beds; ambient voice is extending to same-day emergency care, an NHSE investment agreement is being finalized and an AI/data ethics committee created. Tranche 3 due June 2027.
milestone.why: Shows adoption is now measured by validated benefits rather than go-live: the buying criterion for UK trusts.

brefsEurope.title: Mid Cheshire rolls out Lyrebird ambient voice after successful trial
brefsEurope.summary: After a trial in same-day emergency care, dermatology, rheumatology and urology, extension to the ED, paediatrics, orthopaedics and stroke; 300+ staff trained.

brefsEurope.title: X-on Health offers three free months to practices hit by Silicon Practice insolvency
brefsEurope.summary: Silicon Practice, now in administration, left hundreds of GP practices (up to 600 per GP Online) without websites and online consultations; X-on offers its Surgery Assist Lite AI assistant and Omni Consultations.

word.definition: EU regulation (in force since March 2025) governing patient access to their data and the secure reuse of that data for research and innovation.

how.t: Hospitals and other data holders must make data available.
Users request access through a dedicated body.
Secondary use largely applies from March 2029, with some categories (genomics, trials) in March 2031.

word.why: VC angle: creates a regulated health-data market; commercial uses such as advertising or insurance are excluded, steering business models toward research and product development.

startups.name: Owkin
